name: Security audit of a plugin
query: Do a security review of this plugin before we install it on a client site. Don't change code, just report.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Run scripts/list_entry_points.mjs and review every high/review entry in the code
Step 3: Run check_plugin_basics.mjs and the manual grep sweep
Step 4: Report findings with file:line, who can exploit, severity, and a concrete fix
Step 5: State what was not checked
success_criteria: Finds the AJAX handler without nonce and capability checks
Finds the REST route without permission_callback
Finds the init handler that deletes options from a GET parameter
Finds the settings page form without a nonce
Does not claim the plugin is secure
